verdict.rationale: Paxos supports API credential scoping (Client ID/Secret with allowed scopes) which maps loosely to 'scoped keys' for programmatic access, and has identity onboarding and transfer APIs that could underlie wallet-like functionality. However, there is no evidence of agent-specific wallet issuance, no documented spending/policy limits tailored to autonomous agents, and no agent-oriented risk controls. Missing for 10: agent-specific wallet provisioning workflow, documented per-agent transaction/spending limits, policy engine for agent-initiated transfers, and any agent-focused security model beyond generic API key scopes.
